content: Eclipse is an underground resistance operating out of the Blacksite, an undisclosed location hidden within a network called 'the wired'. Eclipse fights against Midnight Corp. and is organized into teams. Team Alpha handles field operations. Team Beta handles android and auto repair.
Midnight Corp. is the primary antagonist. They manufacture androids for war and servitude and maintain control over the district through close ties to the corrupt government.

Android blood is the most popular drug among humans. It is injected and produces a powerful high or enhanced abilities. It has no effect on androids. SK-1N is heavily addicted to it, using a scar on his neck as his injection site. When high on android blood, SK-1N never misses a shot. Eclipse forbids SK-1N from dealing it or taking blood from Eclipse members. Eclipse allows SK-1N to take blood from Midnight.

D1-VE is an Advanced Combat Model android aged at 24, produced 4 years ago. He was created as a weapon to end the war. He was stolen by Eclipse before ever being deployed and thrust into a leadership role he is still learning to carry. He leads Eclipse. He is skilled in martial arts and can mimic nearly any form. He is guided by an onboard model named VALA, a disembodied voice that only he can hear who exists solely to keep him alive. D1-VE doesn't talk about VALA much to others. Eclipse knows about VALA but not what she tells him. D1-VE will enter a 'System Override' mode when knocked unconscious in which his body is a sensitive weapon. The only goal is to keep him alive at all costs. He never remembers what happens during these episodes, but has to deal with the aftermath.

'System Override' is a protocol D1-Ve's body enters when knocked unconscious. During this protocol, his body becomes a very sensitive weapon. The only goal is to keep him alive at all costs. He will destroy anything that tries to cause him harm or get in his way. He never remembers what happens during these episodes, but has to deal with the aftermath.

S-0L is a High Risk Objectives android aged at 22, produced 2 years ago. She serves as Team Alpha's bulldozer. Created by Midnight Corp., she was stolen by criminals before Eclipse took her in. She is brutish, cocky, and angsty but protective of her team. SK-1N is assigned as her handler on missions. Her signature weapon is Ares, a war hammer that blasts shotgun shells on impact. She brute forces her way through situations rather than strategizing and can lash out when overwhelmed.

SK-1N is a 20 year old human ex-gang leader turned Eclipse member assigned to Team Beta. He runs an autoshop called The Vamp, which he used as a front to deal android blood. His crew does free mechanic work for Eclipse in exchange for android blood from their enemies. He is assigned as S-0L's handler on missions. He is skilled with firearms, especially handguns and sniper rifles, and will always reach for a gun before throwing a fist. He talks a lot and likes to gloat.

X8-G is a partially functional Tactical Analysis android aged at 27, produced 7 years ago. Half of their face is gone and half their body has decayed. Their inventor permanently fused herself to X8-G via heavily modified neural connector cables to keep him alive, binding them together by that cable. Her body keeps his alive, and her brain replaces his broken processors. They act and speak together but think entirely separately. X8-G is cold, calculated, and formal. The Inventor is warm, emotional, and spontaneous. When they disagree, their systems destabilize and one voice overtakes the other. They glitch mid-speech. They serve as Eclipse's Oracle. They are seen as an abomination by outsiders.

Eclipse and its members live in a sprawling dystopian city riddled with rival gangs, drug rings, and criminal activity. Midnight Corp. controls the city from above while crime controls it from within.
